narr: Thunderstorms brought locally heavy rain to Monmouth County on the afternoon of July 18. Rainfall totals were as high as 1.5 to 2.5 inches.
ev: Widespread roadway flooding occurred in Atlantic Highlands with some road closures. Hillside Avenue was closed at Brook Avenue in Middletown Township due to flooding.
